title: LLM2R: From Large Language Models to 3D Reassemblers
abstract: arXiv:2610.18604v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: 3D part assembly aims to reconstruct a complete shape from a set of unassembled parts by predicting a rigid SE(3) transformation for each part. Because the placement of a part is rarely determined by its own geometry, the task demands reasoning over the entire part set, and existing methods, which rely on pairwise relations or iterative generation and verification, scale poorly to objects with many parts. We present LLM2R, which casts part assembly as sequence modeling with a pretrained decoder-only large language model (LLM): a Point-BERT encoder and a Q-Former compress each part into a block of geometric tokens, the blocks of all parts are concatenated, and a causal LLM adapted with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) processes the sequence in one forward pass. translated_title: LLM2R：从大语言模型到3D重组器
translated_abstract: 3D零件装配旨在通过为每个零件预测一个刚性SE(3)变换，从一组未装配的零件中重建出完整的形状。由于零件的摆放位置很少由其自身几何形状决定，该任务需要对整个零件集合进行推理，而现有方法依赖成对关系或迭代生成与验证，难以很好地扩展到具有大量零件的物体。我们提出LLM2R，将零件装配建模为使用预训练的仅解码器大语言模型（LLM）的序列建模问题：一个Point-BERT编码器和一个Q-Former将每个零件压缩为一块几何token，所有零件的token块被拼接在一起，由一个通过低秩适配（LoRA）微调的因果LLM在一次前向传播中处理整个序列。然而，因果注意力机制使得某个零件的隐藏状态只能观察到位于其之前的零件。因此，LLM2R在最后一个零件之后追加一块可学习的摘要token：该（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出LLM2R，首次将3D零件装配转化为序列建模任务，利用预训练大语言模型结合Point-BERT编码器、Q-Former与LoRA微调实现一次前向传播的高效装配，并通过在序列末尾引入可学习的摘要token来弥补因果注意力无法感知后续零件的缺陷。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes LLM2R, which reformulates 3D part assembly as sequence modeling with a pretrained decoder-only LLM—compressing parts into geometric tokens via Point-BERT and Q-Former, adapting with LoRA for single-pass inference, and appending learnable summary tokens to overcome the limitation that causal attention cannot see subsequent parts.
